sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 269 (per-loop search + campsitePaging.do, all 258 campsites parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead, same day included. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again. Register at the main office 3-8 pm; the registering camper must be 18 or older and present throughout the stay.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/hamlin-beach-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=269 (Booking Window: Campsite 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'If you make your reservation within 3 days of your arrival you can book a 1-night stay'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 continuous nights ... must leave the site and facility for 48 hours'; 'CAMPER REGISTRATION at MAIN OFFICE: Starting at 3PM until 8PM'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/hamlin-beach-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=269 ('Hamlin Beach State Park 2027 Camping Season: Loop A, B,C,D E, F - Friday, May 21, 2027 - Sunday, October 10, 2027'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Every site has electric: 174 at 30 amp and 84 at 50 amp, spread over all six loops. Water spigots are shared.

hookups.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/hamlin-beach-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=269 ('There are no full hook-up (water/sewer) sites. Water spigots are for public use, no permanent attachments.') + ReserveAmerica site list ('Electric Hookup available: 30 amp' 174, '50 amp' 84), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The park counts 264 campsites; ReserveAmerica sells 258 in loops A-F, all back-in, 216 listed at 40 ft and 38 at 30 ft. Loops D, E and F are pet-free. Ash trees cut for emerald ash borer have left a more open canopy.

sites.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/hamlin-beach-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=269 ('264 tent and trailer campsites'; 'Campsite (258)'; 'staff have had to cut down a large quantity of trees leaving a more open canopy') + ReserveAmerica site list ('40 Back-In' 216, '30 Back-In' 38, 4 with no driveway listed; loops 'Hamlin Loop D (NO PETS)', 'E (NO PETS)', 'F (NO PETS)'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/hamlin-beach-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=269 ('individual campsites with showers and dumping stations'; 'Water spigots are for public use'; Services and Amenities 'Dump Station', 'Laundry', 'Showers', 'Water Drinking', 'Convenience Store'), read 2026-10-21

note: OPRHP on Lake Ontario; loops A-F are set back inland from the bluff and beach. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica (parkId 269): reservable, 264 sites (RA sells 258), 40-ft max, showers/laundry/dump/water, phone 585-964-2462. Changed electric 30 -> 50 (84 of 258 sites are 50-amp). Added no water/sewer at sites, 2027 season May 21 - Oct 10, 9-month window, 2-night minimum waived within 3 days, 14-night max, all back-in, camp store. Fees left as read 2026-10-12.
